rows.grounds: fused demonstrative with amodaka; accusative singular neuter
compound of sarva, deva, and priya; nominative singular neuter

items.question: What substance is declared all-gods-dear and beloved?
premises: It is dear to all gods.
items.inference: The amodaka substance is praised as beloved by all gods.
uncertainties: The fused form etadāmodakaṃ is analyzed without splitting the row.
items.plain_english: This amodaka substance, dear to all gods, O beloved.
